outcomes._source: plan rev3 A3 (fixed before the A3 run, 2026-10-06): A2 outputs at m = 4, curated (site partition S_tau at 0.01 and inf) and pooled background (mix@1, mix@0.5), as d' vs abs; secondary: A1 (ii) = mean d'(N1, N2), (iii) - abs = mean d'(Z1, Z2), (ii) - (iii), at tau 0.01 and inf; G (A_abs <= 0.98) for the primary A2 outcomes as a further secondary; review 2026-10-06: A1 KB-matched N1 - Zm added (plan A1: used with the tiers and RQ1); A1 secondary outcomes are not blind (A1 tier tables already seen), A2 primary outcomes are
outcomes._neither: sensitivity (review 2026-10-06): the four A2 primary outcomes recomputed on draws whose m = 4 comparison set has neither an O-neighbour nor a KB-neighbour (removes the distance-dependent neighbour composition of random sets)

predictors._source: analysis rev3 RQ1: external KB-O distance = category and tag-distance rank (raw tag-JS as sensitivity). rank = tag-JS rank of O among the KB's other sites (1 = nearest), standardised; tag = raw tag-JS, standardised; samecat = same category (0/1)

model: interval of record (fixed before the run, review 2026-10-06): y ~ x + (1|KB) + (1|O) + (0+x|KB) + (0+x|O), independent crossed random intercepts and slopes, REML, Wald 95% interval of the fixed slope (statsmodels MixedLM, variance components). Reference: random intercepts only; robustness: OLS slope with a two-way (KB x O) bootstrap. Ceiling sensitivities for the primary outcomes: cells with A_abs <= ceiling only, and probit(A_abs) as a covariate (changes the estimand; difficulty may mediate distance)
reading_rule: analysis rev3 RQ1 + completion (fixed before the run): slope < 0 on rank/tag (> 0 on samecat) with the interval excluding 0 = near gains more; interval including 0 = no distance interaction (refutation); slope > 0 on rank/tag with the interval excluding 0 = near gains less (opposite of the RQ1 hypothesis). Each outcome is read separately; when the primary outcomes disagree, no single 'RQ1 sign' is reported. Main predictor: rank. samecat overlaps with rank and is not read as an independent factor

_a5_source: plan rev3 A5: A3 on the 30-site subset for the three models (A5 A1 part and A5 A2 part outputs); same outcomes, predictors, model and reading rule as the main A3; rank within the subset (1-29)
